name: World's Greatest Stretch
steps: Step one foot into a long lunge and plant both hands inside the front foot with the rear leg extended.
Lower the elbow nearest the front foot toward its instep, hold briefly, then open your chest and reach that hand upward.
Return your hand to the floor, shift your hips back to lengthen the front leg and step back into a plank.
Step your opposite foot forward into the lunge and repeat the full sequence, alternating smoothly between both sides for the target duration.
tips: Keep your rear knee lifted off the floor for a deeper stretch or rest it lightly down for support.
Move calmly through each phase and pause briefly with a slow exhale at each end range.
